decisions.reason: As a close, low-cost extension of the pipeline-components range for the firm’s existing infrastructure customers, it is more valuable to retain unless several years of sales had clearly disproved its fit.
Because it builds directly on existing fabrication know-how and broadens the core offer with limited extra commitment, the option value of keeping it remains higher than the savings from dropping it.

After several years the uncertainty around this more distant public-bin product should be largely resolved, and if it has not become a meaningful business by now the growing core infrastructure business is the better use of attention and capacity.

Although it uses the firm’s metalworking and coating capabilities, this waste-bin line with ashtray sits outside the main pipeline business and by 2022 likely no longer justifies keeping multiple variants open if demand has remained limited.

Outdoor public ashtrays are a peripheral line with weaker strategic fit and, once market feedback has had time to emerge, a focused Mittelstand manufacturer would likely redeploy resources to core products or more promising developments.
